title: HW-01 Purchase Order Extraction v1
description: One logical purchase order extracted from one customer-neutral text input. Missing source values are null; line items stay in source order.

purchaseOrderNumber.description: The buyer's PO identifier, kept as text so leading zeros survive.

purchaseOrderDateTime.description: PO issue date normalized to YYYY-MM-DD; not a requested delivery, entry, or cancellation date.

buyerName.description: Buyer party named by the source; never inferred from ship-to or bill-to alone.

shipToInfo.description: Source-supported ship-to name/address as one neutral text value.

paymentTerms.description: Payment terms stated on the order.

buyerCurrency.description: Explicit order currency as a three-letter code. A list of choices is not a selected currency.

totalValue.description: Explicit net product total for this PO, normalized as a decimal string; not a workbook batch total.

lineItems.description: Ordered lines belonging to this PO only; exclude catalog and lookup-only rows.

purchaseOrderLineNumber.description: Printed line number, if present, as text to retain leading zeros.

buyerProductIdentifier.description: Product identifier supplied by the buyer, not a barcode or seller code unless identified as the buyer code.

buyerProductName.description: Product name or description attached to the ordered line.

buyerProductQuantity.description: Ordered quantity normalized as a decimal string.

buyerProductUOM.description: Source wording or code for the ordered quantity's unit when its meaning is supported.

quantityUnit.description: Small normalized unit category. OTHER means an explicit different unit; UNKNOWN means the unit is absent or its code cannot be interpreted.

buyerUnitPrice.description: Explicit per-unit price, normalized as a decimal string.

buyerDeliveryDate.description: Requested delivery date for this line, if the source ties it to the line.
